nodes.description: External function createClone(address target) returns address result and deploys an EIP-1167 minimal proxy clone using inline assembly.
Input address target specifying the implementation contract to clone.
bytes20 representation of target used inside assembly bytecode.
Memory pointer to clone initialization code in assembly.
Return variable receiving the address of the newly created clone.
Inline assembly CREATE opcode deploy call using clone bytecode; low-level unsafe operation.

edges.reason: target parameter is converted to bytes20 targetBytes.
target address determines the clone target embedded in the assembly CREATE operation.
targetBytes is stored into the clone bytecode used by CREATE.
clone memory pointer supplies initialization code to CREATE.
CREATE result is assigned to the result return variable.
createClone executes inline assembly CREATE operation.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter target belongs to the createClone function signature and is only used within this function.
targetBytes exists solely as input to the inline assembly CREATE operation.
clone memory pointer is only used by the inline assembly CREATE operation.
result is assigned directly from the CREATE operation and returned.
